payload.method: Deterministic readiness precedence over exact current SPO evidence state: reviewed physical source, then exercised byte-canonical review adapter, then a structurally accepted exact producer diagnostic plan, then a refused plan requiring repair. Exact local fixture custody is a separate readiness axis. External evidence rank is context and never changes the lane.
payload.non_scalar_priority_policy: No opaque or additive score is emitted. Rows within one lane are deliberately unordered. Selection within a lane requires explicit review of safety value, calibrated machine-readable data availability, clock/reference/operator completeness, uncertainty, validity, quality, provenance, observability gates, independent validation, and producer capacity.

lane_definitions.selection_rule: Exact configuration already has reviewed physical-source custody but no qualified observation or physical phase.
Exact configuration has an exercised byte-canonical review adapter, but its admitted evidence is simulation-only and no physical source is qualified.
Device project has an exact, structurally accepted diagnostic-plan fixture, but no exercised configuration-specific physical producer intake; local SPO fixture custody is recorded separately.
Device project's diagnostic-plan fixture is structurally refused; repair and regenerate the exact plan bytes before a physical producer intake can be designed.
